metas.name: His Girl Friday
metas.description: A fast-talking newspaper editor tries to stop his star reporter (and ex-wife) from remarrying and leaving the business, in one of the fastest, wittiest screwball comedies ever made. (1940)

metas.name: The General
metas.description: A Southern railroad engineer chases his stolen locomotive - and the woman he loves - straight through enemy lines, in Buster Keaton's silent action-comedy masterpiece. (1926)

metas.name: White Zombie
metas.description: A young woman is turned into a mindless zombie by a Haitian voodoo master in this atmospheric horror film, one of the earliest feature-length zombie movies ever made. (1932)

metas.name: House on Haunted Hill
metas.description: An eccentric millionaire offers five guests $10,000 each to survive one night locked inside a haunted mansion, in this classic Vincent Price horror thriller. (1959)

metas.name: Carnival of Souls
metas.description: After surviving a car accident, a church organist is drawn to an abandoned lakeside pavilion by a ghostly figure, in this eerie independent horror classic. (1962)

metas.name: Beat the Devil
metas.description: A group of shady con artists get stranded in a small Italian port en route to a uranium land deal, in this offbeat comic thriller directed by John Huston. (1953)
